$comment: TEMPLATE, do not put credentials or private endpoints here. To register an OpenAI-compatible gateway as a pi provider, pass your own file at run time with `--models_json /path/to/models.json`; the pipeline bind-mounts it over /opt/pi-config/models.json inside the agent container (see nextflow.config, docker profile). The provider `id` field is the literal model string sent to the baseUrl, so it must match exactly what your gateway expects (e.g. `openai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731`). The API key is NOT stored here: the Nextflow driver delivers it out of band at run time via the `LLM_KEY` secret (agent runtime-API-key mechanism), so no secret ever needs to be committed. This empty-providers default gives pi its built-in catalog only.
